effects.window: Your Main Phase, while this card is in your Graveyard, if you have a monster(s) in your Graveyard other than "Fishborg Launcher", and all of them are WATER
effects.effect: Special Summon this card from your Graveyard. If you do, banish it when it leaves the field.
This card cannot be used as a Synchro Material Monster, except for the Synchro Summon of a WATER monster.
